title: Create Safe Seating
description: Sit on a Create seat to go AFK safely: mobs ignore you, you slowly heal and refill hunger, and phantoms and lightning leave you alone.
body:
**Sit on a Create seat to go AFK safely: mobs ignore you, you slowly heal and refill hunger, and phantoms and lightning leave you alone.**

![Ideal setup](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1750/536/screenshot-png.png)

## At a glance

*   Hostile mobs stop noticing you once you've settled into a seat.
*   Slowly regain health and hunger while you rest. A campfire or cake speeds it up.
*   No phantoms spawn while you're seated.
*   Lightning leaves occupied seats alone.
*   Go AFK and the HUD hides, the camera pulls back, and your hunger stops draining.
*   Works on every Create seat. Server owners can tune or switch off each part.

## Why I made this

You hop on a seat to wait out a build, alt-tab for two minutes, and come back to a creeper crater where you used to be. Seats are where you idle, so they should be the one place the night can't get you.

## Setup

1.  Place any **Create seat**.
2.  Right-click it to **sit down**.
3.  Wait about **10 seconds** for the resting perks to kick in.
4.  Stay still for a minute to drop into **AFK** mode.

## How it works

*   **Mob safety** kicks in after the same ~10 second settle-in as resting. Once it's active, hostile mobs won't pick a seated player as a new target. It won't shake a mob that's already chasing you, so sit down in peace.
*   After roughly **10 seconds**, you slowly regain **health** and **hunger**. Sit by a lit **campfire** and you heal faster, sit by a **cake** and you fill up faster. The cake is never eaten.
*   **Phantoms** won't spawn over a seated player, and a seated player shrugs off **lightning**.
*   The resting perks need a **stationary** seat. The safety perks still cover you on a moving **contraption**, so a train ride keeps the mobs and storms off your back.
*   Take damage and the rest timer resets, so you can't heal your way through a fight. Standing up ends it too.
*   **AFK** mode triggers after about a minute of no input: the **HUD** hides, the view turns **third-person**, and hunger stops draining. Any key, click, or look snaps everything back.

Nothing here is rebalanced for anyone else, and every timer and feature lives in the config.

## Dev note

*   Mob safety only blocks new targeting, it never wipes a mob's current target. That keeps a seat a calm spot to settle into rather than a panic button you slam mid-chase. Sit down before things go wrong, not after.
*   Works with contraptions and stable sublevels.

## Requirements

*   **Create**: required, this is an add-on.
*   **NeoForge 21.1.233** or newer, for **Minecraft 1.21.1**.
